Table 3 and Figure 1 give self-reported alertness in healthy adults receiving four botanical extracts including pomegranate peel. At day 21 pre-dose the blend led placebo by 1.16 points (follow-up p=.03), but the omnibus interaction was p=.07. The study does not isolate arils or measure Parkinson daytime sleepiness.
Lens culinaris agglutinin was a histochemical stain applied to olfactory tissue in an autoimmune encephalomyelitis rat model. The rats were not fed lentils and odor behavior was not tested.
Atlantic cod and seabass were the living study subjects. The study sequenced their nasal microbiota in ambient and manipulated seawater. There was no human seafood intervention or smell outcome.
The chapter discusses restricting manganese-rich foods in a rare inherited transport disorder. It gives no dark-chocolate trial or speech-intelligibility estimate.
The chapter lists dark chocolate among foods rich in manganese to avoid in SLC39A14 deficiency. It provides no exposure contrast for speech in idiopathic Parkinson disease.
